items.description: TheTool is the first Performance-Based ASO (App Store Optimization) tool that allows app or game developers, brands, startups and companies track and optimize theirs apps' visibility on Apple App Store & Google Play Store.

Weglore is a location based photo sharing app that allows users to explore the globe with map navigation and photo markers. The photo series incorporates smart social functions that enable filtering of unwanted photos and sharing photos pertaining to a similar subject. The Weglore mobile app users geolocation to add metadata to photos, and enables users to subscribe to photos aggregated to a particular location, with optional notification settings as well as other functions. The app is free and can be downloaded for Android from Google Play.

The Google Play Developer API allows developers the opportunity to automate tasks concerning subscriptions, in-app purchasing, and general app-management. One may gain access to the API by signing into their Google Developer Console.

Amazon Fulfillment Web Service (Amazon FWS) allows merchants to access Amazon.com's world-class fulfillment capabilities through a simple web services interface. Merchants can programmatically send order information to Amazon with instructions to physically fulfill customer orders on their behalf.
Measure and share real-time local Twitter trends. App uses Twitter, Google Maps and Yahoo Term Extraction APIs.
ToastBank is a forum where users can add and share toasts. You can search through toasts that have been submitted and share the best ones with your friends over Facebook or Twitter.
Allows Box.net users to share files from their Box accounts using TimeBridge, where they can discuss and collaborate around them in real-time with other users.

Using an Arduino with an ethernet shield and some electronic components I built a Twilio powered garage door. It can tell if the garage door is open or closed and it can also activate the garage door opener if desired. In addition I have a program that runs every 15 minutes and checks the garage door. If it is open past 8:00, it sends my wife and I a text message. We can simply reply to close it.

CuteOn.Me is a simple app to solicit shopping advice from your friends. It demonstrates how a real-world application can use awe.sm's batch link creation, metadata association, redirection patterns, conversion tracking, and advanced stats retrieval. Documentation and source available.
140blood is a new Twitter-based multiplayer fantasy game. Choose among 4 exciting adventures in an MMORPG adventure world.

A phone browser to view virtual objects and information around your location. Google Maps mashup portion is at metosphere.com, and the Google Android portion is located at metosphere.com/android-app.html.
likeexchange.net is a website that enables Facebook fan page discovery and helps its members exchange likes with each other.
Dutch mashup that searches multiple auction sites and links to Google Maps to locate the item on sale.

A site that generates code to embed maps created using the My Maps service of Google into websites and blogs. A range of style and presentation options are available to customize map appearance. Users can share maps they create in the library of maps.
Bookafy is an online scheduling and appointment tracking web app. This mashup makes use of the Zendesk Core API for ticket tracking and management.

Frame an ecard using this web tool using photos from your own computer, from a remote site using a web address or from your Flickr account. Then send it via email as an ecard or save it to your Flickr account.
Find where the nearest Starbucks is for each of the OnAIR bus tour stops.

ChumpDump is a new twist on twitter, a game that rewards players for weeding the chumps out of their twitter feed. Data from that game is presented here on ChumpDar, who got dumped on twitter and why. Playable on Android and iPhone.
